subject: CAIQ mapping request — HelixSec procurement: evidence onramp and control navigator
messages:
From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@helixsec.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ mapping request — Redwood inference (HelixSec procurement)

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked us to get a CAIQ-style mapping and a small evidence bundle to unblock our security review. We want: 1) a mapping table that shows Redwood’s CC controls -> your implementation / artifact (short description), 2) representative evidence for a handful of priority controls (runtime telemetry, key rotation/KMS, tenant isolation for hosted API and private deploy), and 3) an owner + ETA for full CAIQ delivery.

Scope note: HelixSec is focused on controls that intersect with tenant data flows and key management; we’ve marked ~40 controls as high-priority in the attached procurement scope (helix-procurement-scope.pdf). Can you confirm you can provide an initial mapping and sample artifacts by 10/20?

If helpful we can accept redacted logs and screenshots; signatures/attestations are required later in the process. Let me know who on your side will own the control mapping and where you’ll stage artifacts.

Appreciate it —
Amanda
Amanda Lee
Security Manager, Helix Security
Amanda.Lee@helixsec.com

Attachment: helix-procurement-scope.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@helixsec.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping request — Redwood inference (HelixSec procurement)

Amanda —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can do an initial CAIQ crosswalk and a short evidence bundle for the 40 high-priority controls. Plan:
- Owner: Naomi will lead the evidence collection and matrix.
- Deliverable 1 (by 2026-10-13): redwood-caiq-matrix-v0.1.xlsx (mapping rows + quick artifact pointer).
- Deliverable 2 (by 2026-10-20): evidence bundle (redacted logs, KMS rotation proof, tenant-isolation runbook excerpt) and an attestation draft for review.

Two clarifying Qs:
1) Do you require signed attestation at the 10/20 milestone or is a draft acceptable until legal finishes procurement?
2) For private deployments, do you want on-prem screenshots (we can produce) or confirmation of customer-managed KMS integration only?

We’ll stage artifacts on a shared Drive folder and share links + short notes per artifact. Naomi — can you kick off the matrix and drop the first version to the Drive link below? Marissa — looping you to confirm runtime telemetry sample extraction and any redaction we should apply.

Drive (staging): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Redwood-Helix-CAIQ

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-caiq-matrix-v0.1.xlsx
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@helixsec.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping request — Redwood inference (HelixSec procurement)

Thanks Sean — I started the matrix and populated the following control areas: authentication & session management, KMS & key rotation, telemetry & runtime logs, tenant isolation (multi-tenant hosted), private deployment boundaries (VPC), and change control.

Quick notes and what I’m attaching:
- runtime-telemetry-sample.log (redacted): example of our streaming request/response telemetry with trace IDs and anonymized client-id.
- kms-rotation-screenshot.png: screenshot of our KMS rotation dashboard (sensitive fields blurred).
- redwood-caiq-matrix-v0.1.xlsx: mapping rows 1–25 completed (priority controls).

On redaction: I removed IPs and user identifiers from logs. If Helix needs raw samples we can arrange an NDA/procurement-side secure transfer, but for initial review the redacted artifacts should be fine.

Regarding private deploy evidence: we can provide a short network diagram and a sample playbook showing how an on-prem KMS/HSM is integrated (customer-managed). For hosted API tenant isolation, I’ll add KV cache and request routing notes to the matrix (how we ensure KV cache per-tenant and cache eviction policies).

ETA check: I expect to push v0.1 to Drive today and then a packaged zip to Drive by 10/19 for your review.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Programs — Redwood Inference

Attachments: runtime-telemetry-sample.log, kms-rotation-screenshot.png
From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@helixsec.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@helixsec.com
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping request — Redwood inference (HelixSec procurement)

Naomi — this is great, thank you. The redacted telemetry looks fine for preliminary technical review. Procurement flagged that we will need an authorized attestation (DocuSign) for a subset of controls (listed in the procurement PDF) before we finalize the contract. A draft attestation is fine for now, but we’d like a signed attestation for the scoped controls by 10/27 if possible.

Also: Helix needs a short explanation (1 pager) of how tenant isolation is enforced across hosted vs. private modes — particularly around cache separation and KV encryption. Can you confirm whether that 1-pager can be included in the 10/20 bundle or if it needs legal sign-off first?

Thanks —
Amanda
Amanda Lee
Security Manager, Helix Security

- Evidence bundle: redacted telemetry sample, KMS rotation proof, network diagram for private deploy, sample playbook excerpts.
- Attestation draft by 10/20; signed DocuSign copy by 10/27 (legal is on the loop).

Action items (internal):

- I’ll prepare the tenant isolation 1-pager and coordinate legal for the attestation flow.
- Sean: confirm any product notes that should be included for tenant KV cache (I’ll add the cache eviction policy excerpt).

We’ll upload the bundle to the Drive link and post the DocuSign when ready: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Redwood-Helix-CAIQ
